summary: Reviewed and updated against Flagger1.45.0 and loadtester0.39.0; controller behavior, routing, gates, metrics and GitOps examples corrected.
findings: Cumulative failedChecks and promotion-failure canary fallback were incorrectly described as consecutive failures/always old-version rollback.
Fixed exclusive iterations/stepWeight/stepWeights and real chart/CRD/API fields; ConfigMap tracking is on by default.
Manual gates are in-memory and name/namespace scoped; rollback hooks request rollback on success, metadata is literal and HTTP204 fails.
Fixed unsupported native PagerDuty and Teams Workflows assumptions; loadtester lacks k6.
Corrected Prometheus metric semantics and provider behavior: CloudWatch region supported; Datadog first/oldest and null-as-zero caveat.
Corrected Flux ownership and unsupported Canary notification event source; reviewed AppMesh EoS and ingress/OSM status.
Reworked 17 diagrams to match controller sequencing, traffic ownership, gates and image promotion.
validation: 92 fences:66YAML20Bash2JS2JSON;42 CRDs+18 spec fragments;0 syntax/schema errors.
Three actual Helm renders verified Flagger, loadtester and Podinfo ownership.
26 pinned-code HTTP/gate/Datadog leaf tests pass.
11 PromQL expression +6 alert timing cases pass promtool3.14.0.
17 diagrams composition9/9,4viewport containment each, all visually inspected and PNG regenerated.
No live infrastructure or external notifications executed.
